rationale_one_line: Ollama's MLX engine is an architecture swap, so the SCHEMATIC diagram-first framework fits, rendered in Ollama's own paper-white documentation brand.
writing_tone_notes: Understated, documentation-first, no hype. Let the install command and the speed numbers carry it. Peer-to-peer builder voice. Contractions where natural. The contrast (cloud out vs stays home) carries the praise.
do_rules: Lead the caption with the star metric, never a version number
Keep copy terminal-plain and concrete (run, weights, tokens, disk)
Use the CLI-green accent only as the local / success signal
Show the MLX engine as a diagram and prove it with a terminal scene
dont_rules: Do not say v0.30.10 or any version number anywhere in the caption
Do not add brand colors beyond black, white, gray and the one CLI green
Do not repeat any phrase across tweet, why-this-one, and scene copy
